criteria: Current Missouri primary explicitly enrolls dogs with spontaneous CD20+ large-cell B-cell lymphoma, naive or relapsed, clinically well, >10kg. Investigator bloodwork and no primary GI/lung involvement; no Apoquel/mycophenolate/cyclosporine/azathioprine; prednisone washout >=72h. Lymphodepleting chemotherapy plus xenogeneic CAR-T, at least seven visits in21days then long follow-up. Study covers staging/treatment/rechecks, adverse events up to$4000, completion stipend$2000 for future VHC treatment. Minnesota independent current protocol remains ON HOLD (10-50kg/48h criteria must not replace Missouri's). Ohio remains sponsor-listed only; confirm local slot. Missouri criteria cannot globally exclude an Ohio candidate when Ohio criteria are unpublished; site-specific clinical screening remains explicit.
decision: Confirmed current Missouri organizer protocol and fresh Web agree; the October15 cached ON HOLD version is superseded for Missouri. Move Missouri from inactive to active sites in the one existing record; Minnesota remains inactive. No new trial.
